intro: Oil and natural gas make Trinidad and Tobago one of the Caribbean's richest countries.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: It is a big exporter of liquefied natural gas, ammonia and methanol. Tourism matters more on Tobago.

chapters.title: Cocoa
text: Trinitario cocoa is prized by chocolate makers.

keyTerms.meaning: Chemicals made from oil and gas.

cardGroups.title: Made in Trinidad and Tobago
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Trinidad and Tobago makes and sells to the world.
